Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
From which date do Articles 26 to 42 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (notification of conformity assessment bodies) apply?

response.text: As of which date are Articles 26 to 42 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which cover the notification of conformity assessment bodies, applicable?
